shortDescription: Sui said on X that SlushWallet has simplified its first deposit process, allowing users to enter Sui with a bank card or assets from 25 chains. According to Odaily, bridging and swapping can both be completed within SlushWallet.

title: SlushWallet Lowers Sui Entry Barrier With Bank Card and 25-Chain Deposits
